caption: Psalm 22’s bulls and lions can illustrate the deadly hostility around Jesus. But the broad danger image predicts no execution method and John never cites it.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Did Psalm 22 predict deadly enemies? The psalmist is surrounded by bulls and lions. John describes leaders shouting for Jesus to be crucified.
slides.body: The psalmist is surrounded by bulls and lions. John describes leaders shouting for Jesus to be crucified.
slides.heading: Did Psalm 22 predict deadly enemies?
